hold_reason: two execution-critical components of the historical estimand are not portable to Massive as written

outcome.builder: t5_outcomes.build_outcomes — REUSED byte-identical, output path overridden; a second implementation of entry/maturity semantics is how families drift

anchors.measured_at: T-2 close, strictly before the window opens
anchors.dedup: row_number by universe preference sp500<nasdaq<russell2k, rn=1

blocks.halves: median split by rank WITHIN each decision date

recovered_exactly.statistic: one-sided Z_rank = R_s / sqrt(V_s), bounded blockwise Mann-Whitney / AUC, analytically studentized
recovered_exactly.multiplicity: search-wide max Z_rank over all k claims, ONE permutation mapping applied to every claim
recovered_exactly.promotion: Z_rank_obs > p95( max-null Z_rank ) from THIS run's own permutations, STRICTLY greater
recovered_exactly.raw_theta: magnitude only; never a promotion criterion

grammar.excluded: the 3-bar grammar (million-claim scale) is NOT in T1 V1
grammar.evidence_status: a SEPARATE localization family; NOT independent evidence from 1H — same episode universe, same outcome

temporal_reading_refined.consequence: every X input precedes the decision point; there is no lookahead in the outcome path
temporal_reading_refined.classification_retained: POST_EXPOSURE_SESSION_LOCALIZATION — the anchor is still not knowable at M1
temporal_reading_refined.correction: an earlier phrasing risked implying the construct is unimplementable; it is not — it is simply not decidable at M1

execution_critical_gaps.what: anchors() sets vol_anchor = atr_14 / close, read from legacy bars at the T-2 close
execution_critical_gaps.why_blocked: the Massive coarse layer carries only OHLCV and coverage fields — there is no atr_14
execution_critical_gaps.requires: a Massive-native ATR-14 whose definition provably matches the legacy column
execution_critical_gaps.forbidden: substituting a plausible ATR — that would be inventing a blocking variable

execution_critical_gaps.what: the historical family is 157 searchable tokens over three position families, k_final_candidate 35715
execution_critical_gaps.why_blocked: those claims are evaluated on the legacy 15m TOKEN surface; Massive has T states but not that token layer
execution_critical_gaps.consequence: the family cannot be enumerated, so multiplicity cannot be bound to a member count
execution_critical_gaps.forbidden: registering the three position pairs as three tests — the historical family was never three tests

not_blockers: the population — 8,588 anchors with complete exact opening-hour support
forbidden_if_resumed: using 8,117 historical overlap as the primary population
adding M1->M3, M1->M4 or any unregistered pair
treating a position pair as a T-state transition
opening an all-session or all-12-label search
appending EMA or RVOL conditions absent from the historical prespec
calling the preserved-set complement a historical negative
promoting the 1D anchor to a standalone hypothesis
independence_limitation: a SEPARATE localization family; NOT independent evidence from 1H — same episode universe, same outcome
next_required: port ATR-14 to Massive 1D with a definition proven to match the legacy atr_14 column, OR register a different blocking variable pre-Y
build the Massive 15m token layer, or register a different claim family with its own multiplicity treatment
